# STEP 1: Initialization — Master Architecture Blueprint

## Project Directory Structure

```
RetroArcade/
├── public/
│   └── index.html              # Main entry point with canvas container
│
├── shared/                       # Reusable utility layer across all games
│   ├── pool.js                  # Object pooling system (projectiles, particles)
│   ├── particleManager.js       # Centralized particle manager (500 cap)
│   ├── inputController.js      # Unified dual-input: Keyboard + Gamepad API
│   ├── audioSynth.js           # Web Audio API synthesizer for SFX/music
│   ├── vfxSystem.js            # Camera shake, hit-stop, motion trails, shockwaves
│   ├── noiseFunctions.js       # Simplex/Perlin noise generators
│   ├── collisionEngine.js      # Hand-written physics/collision logic
│   └── mathUtils.js             # Vector3, matrix utilities, easing functions
│
├── [GameName]/                   # Isolated game directory (exact name)
│   ├── index.html               # Game-specific entry point
│   ├── main.js                  # Application bootstrap & Vite dev server config
│   ├── game/                    # Core gameplay logic
│   │   ├── gameLoop.js          # Main game loop with state machine
│   │   ├── gameState.js         # State management (menu, playing, paused, win/loss)
│   │   └── scoreSystem.js       # Scoring, lives, level progression
│   ├── entities/                # Game objects
│   │   ├── player.js            # Player character with input handling
│   │   ├── enemy.js             # Enemy AI and behavior patterns
│   │   ├── projectile.js        # Projectile physics and pooling
│   │   └── powerup.js           # Collectible powerups (if applicable)
│   │   └── environment.js       # Background elements, platforms, obstacles
│   ├── systems/                 # Game systems
│   │   ├── renderSystem.js      # Scene setup, camera, lighting, post-processing
│   │   ├── physicsSystem.js     # Collision detection and response
│   │   ├── aiSystem.js          # Enemy AI decision trees
│   │   └── audioSystem.js       # Audio management and mixing
│   ├── assets/                  # Procedural asset generators
│   │   ├── textureGenerator.js  # Canvas API texture generation
│   │   ├── meshFactory.js       # Procedural geometry creation
│   │   └── soundGenerator.js   # Synthesized audio assets
│   └── config.json              # Game-specific configuration
│
├── package.json                  # Vite dependencies, Three.js peer dep
├── vite.config.js               # Development server configuration
└── README.md                    # Project documentation
```

## Compliance Statement

### Anti-Lazy Directive Compliance ✅
- **Zero placeholder syntax**: Every function will contain complete, executable logic
- **No `// ... rest of code`** patterns — all branches implemented
- **Production-ready output**: Code compiles and runs without missing pieces

### Strict Memory Management Compliance ✅
- **Object pooling**: All projectiles, particles, and entities use pooled instances
- **Explicit disposal**: `.dispose()` called on geometries, materials, textures when recycled
- **Particle cap**: Hard limit of 500 active particles via centralized manager with LRU eviction
- **InstancedMesh usage**: Applied to all repeated geometry (bullets, enemies, effects)

### Sequential Output Protocol Compliance ✅
- Files written in dependency order: shared utilities → game core → entities → systems → assets
- Token overflow handling: Resume from exact truncation point without preamble repetition
